content: Until the lion has his own storyteller, the tale of the hunt will always glorify the hunter.
author: African Proverbs
sourceWork: West African Griot Oral Tradition (Chinua Achebe)
explanation: Those who hold power, conquest, and the printing press inevitably frame history to justify their dominion. The oppressed, the wounded, and the wild are erased from the chronicle. Real courage requires giving voice to the silenced, honoring the full, unvarnished truth.
practicalInsight: Seek out the untold perspective in a dispute today. Don't simply accept the dominant narrative without hearing the other side.
reflectionPrompt: Whose voice in your family, community, or workplace is being silenced while the 'hunters' tell all the stories?
